role: State agency consulted on cultural-historic resource impacts
stance_basis: consulted on cultural-historic resource methodology with no stated position for or against the project
summary: The State Cultural Heritage Preservation Office was consulted during the inter-agency coordination phase of the study to discuss potential impacts of the transit alternatives on cultural-historic resources. Based on those meetings, a cultural-historic impact analysis methodology was developed for the study. No explicit support for or opposition to any alternative is attributed to the Office.
complaint_summary: The State Cultural Heritage Preservation Office met with study staff to discuss potential impacts of the alternatives on cultural-historic resources, resulting in the development of a cultural-historic impact analysis methodology.
summary_quote: Meetings were also held with members of the State Cultural Heritage Preservation Office to discuss potential impacts of the alternatives on cultural-historic resources.
